claim: Works offline after the first visit
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; load online, set the context offline, reload, and assert the sample app remains usable

claim: Words and recall activity stay in this browser unless the learner opens checkout or verifies a license
sandbox: fresh /demo context; intercept the whole recall flow and assert every request is same-origin

claim: Free holds 20 words and Plus holds 100 words
where: landing facts, add limit, settings, terms, README
sandbox: fresh free and cached-Plus contexts; assert imports at 20 and 100 pass and imports at 21 and 101 fail without writes

claim: Exports the word sheet as CSV
sandbox: fresh /demo context; export and assert the header plus one row for each of six samples

claim: Exports and imports a portable JSON backup
sandbox: export the six-word demo bundle and import the downloaded file into a clean real namespace

claim: Demo changes never touch the learner's real sheet
where: landing action note, demo banner, README
sandbox: create a real-only word, enter /demo, verify namespace separation, leave demo, and verify the real word remains

claim: After seven days away, the return set contains at most five oldest due words
sandbox: deterministic scheduler clock with eight due words and an eight-day lapse

claim: Confidence is recorded separately from correctness
sandbox: deterministic scheduler assertion that high confidence cannot turn an incorrect answer into a success interval
